description: Generate speech from input. Consumes usage in the connected project; live usage can be billed. Before generation, use whoami to verify project, environment, scopes, credit and limits. Local stdio returns inline audio, or output_path and bytes when a path is supplied. For integration code only, use get_started without generating audio.

output_path.description: Absolute file path to write the audio to.

voice.description: Voice id from list_voices. Omit for the account default.
